category.reason: The task requires restricting the return flights by arrival time and comparing their prices while keeping the selected outbound flight fixed.

instruction.en: With the selected outbound flight unchanged, select the cheapest return flight that arrives between 10:00 and 10:30.
instruction.zh: 在已选中的出发航班不变的情况下，选择 10:00 ~ 10:30 间到达的价格最便宜的到达航班。
